name: doc-accordion-group
purpose: The FAQ and "expand for detail" block of a documentation page. It reads the `title` of each `DocAccordionItem` child to build the triggers and renders the child body in the panel, so an author writes only titles and prose. It always ships as a card (surface, outer rule, radius) so a run of rows reads as one closed group in an open prose column. Built on `Accordion` at `size="large"`.
useWhen: A list of questions with answers at the end of a guide.
Optional detail that would interrupt the main path of a page (edge cases, troubleshooting).
avoidWhen: For steps the reader must follow in order — use `DocSteps`.
For alternative paths through the same instruction — use `DocTabs`.
Inside an application screen — use `Accordion` directly.
related: Accordion` — the design-system surface it renders on.
bestPractices: Write each title as the full question the reader would ask.
Keep answers short; link out for anything longer than a few paragraphs.
Open at most one entry by default.

props.name: type
props.doc: Whether one or several entries can be open at once.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The `DocAccordionItem` children, in order. Each child's `title` and `defaultOpen` are read; its body is rendered inside the panel.
